items.text: haan ji
kal tak
thik hai

items.context: kya aapko aur samay chahiye payment ke liye?
items.text: thik hai

items.context: kya aap poora amount ek sath de sakte hain?
items.text: haan chal jayega

items.context: kya aapko payment split karna hai?
items.text: nahi abhi nahi
mujhe thoda aur samay chahiye payment ke liye
kya main apna payment do hisso me kar sakta hu
kal tak main poora paisa jama kar dunga
mera account number hai dois ek dair teen char sat
abhi thoda financial problem chal rahi hai mujhe extension chahiye
main pehla installment aaj transfer kar dunga baki kal kar dunga
kya aap mujhe payment ki exact due date bata sakte hain

items.context: kya aapko payment delay karna hai?
items.text: thik hai thoda aur samay chahiye mujhe payment karne ke liye

items.context: kya aap payment split karwana chahte hain?
items.text: ji haan main apna payment do parts me karne ka soch raha hu

items.context: kab tak aap payment kar payenge?
items.text: main agle mahine 20 tarik ko poora amount jama kar dunga

items.context: kya aapko extension chahiye payment ke liye?
items.text: mujhe ye bataiye ki extension ke liye kya process hai

items.context: extension lene par koi extra charge lagega?
items.text: agar main thoda aur samay lekar payment karta hu to koi fine lagega
mera account number hai do panch shoon in maaf teen naa do ke aath nau saja main payment kal tak kar dunga
main abhi thoda financial tension me hu toh mera request hai ki mujhe apna payment ek hafta aur extend kar diya jaye
kya main apna payment baat me kar sakta hu kyunki abhi mere paas poora amount nahin hai kuch hisso me transfer karne ki ijazat do

items.context: kab tak aap payment kar denge agar extension mile?
items.text: main account number do doosar pandrah shoon ek taarik ko payment kar dunga extension kab tak milega

items.context: kya aap apna payment split karna chahte hain?
items.text: mujhe payment split karne ki suvidha chahiye sir main do part me paise jama karunga

items.context: extension dene par kya penalty lagegi?
items.text: agar mujhe ek hafte ka extension mil jaye to main poora amount bina kisi penalty ke de dunga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: ask_extension - asks for more time or to split the payment
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
